MESSAGE.value: Fix some regressions, particularly in the update backend - bootc hosts that don't track an image now show updates again - error banner clears after an appropriate amount of time - stopped re-running update fetching and downloading for queued offline updates - refresh() now resets the restart state - cancelTonight() reports errors when they happen instead of failing quietly - if scheduling one half of the updates fail, both get canceled so you don't end up with half an update scheduled - timer's image check takes the system lock while refreshing the bootc status cache - if a widget update times out, all are marked failed - fixed some comments - stop ignoring helper's new failure exit codes - stop holding system lock for bootc through the network check, but hold it when refreshing the cache
oh it's onlyoffice, not openoffice. also fix test.
